texts.t:rdm:h1:refer: Thola ukuthi It imele ini emushweni odlule.
texts.t:rdm:h1:num: Funda umbhalo kanye ukuze uthole umbono oyinhloko.

texts.t:rdm:h1:where: Funda umbhalo kanye ukuze uthole umbono oyinhloko.
texts.t:rdm:h1:when: Funda amagama akhombisa ukulandelana, njengo-First, Then, Next no-Finally.
texts.t:rdm:h1:ask: Qhathanisa inketho ngayinye nombhalo, eyodwa ngesikhathi.

texts.t:rdm:h1:ends: Sho ngokuzwakala uhlamvu lokuqala lwegama ngalinye.

texts.r:skill:e.e1.alpha: Amagama alula ukukhumbula uma wazi umsindo wawo wokuqala nohlamvu lokuqala. Sho imisindo ngokuzwakala ngenkathi ufunda.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.greet: Uma uhlangana nomuntu, thi **Hello**. Uma uhamba, thi **Goodbye**. Sho igama lakho nge-**My name is ...**.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.numcol: Funda amagama ezinombolo njengo-one, two, three... namagama emibala njengo-red, blue, yellow...
texts.r:skill:e.e1.family: mother (mum), father (dad), grandmother (grandma), baby (ingane encane kakhulu): la ngamagama abantu emndenini wakho.
texts.r:skill:e.e1.class: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Sho izinto ekilasini lakho ngesiNgisi.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.noun: Amagama abiza izinto, njengo-rabbit (isilwane esinezindlebe ezinde), bird (isilwane esindizayo) no-fish (isilwane esibhukudayo), abizwa ngokuthi **amabizo**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.verb: Amagama akhombisa isenzo, njengo-jump (ukukhuphukela emoyeni), run (ukuhamba ngokushesha) no-eat (ukuba nokudla), abizwa ngokuthi **izenzo**.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.like: **I like ...** kusho ukuthi uyakujabulela okuthile. **I have ...** kusho ukuthi okuthile kungokwakho.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.sent: Ngemva kwe-I, sebenzisa **am**. Ngemva kwe-You, sebenzisa **are**. Umusho uhamba ngalolu hlelo: 'ngubani → ayini / yini abayenzayo'.
texts.r:skill:e.e2.read: Uma ufunda, qala ngokufuna amagama avela embuzweni emibhalweni.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.build: Umusho uhamba ngalolu hlelo: 'ngubani → wenzani → ini'. Ngemva kwe-He, i-She noma igama lomuntu, engeza **-s** esenzweni.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.pron: Esikhundleni segama, ungasebenzisa i-**He**, i-**She**, i-**It**, i-**They** noma i-**We**.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.tense: Ezintweni ezenzeka manje noma ezenzeka kaningi, sebenzisa i-**present**. Ezintweni ezenzeke kakade, sebenzisa i-**past**: engeza **-ed** ekugcineni kwesenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.routine: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Sho umsebenzi wakho wansuku zonke ngesiNgisi.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.read: Funda umbhalo bese uthola ukuthi ngubani owenze ini, nokuthi nini.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.abc1: Aphabhethi linezinhlamvu **ezinkulu** nezinhlamvu **ezincane**. Amapheya amaningi abukeka ehlukene, ngakho awafunde linye ngalinye. Qaphela ngokukhethekile izinhlamvu ezibukeka zifana, njengo-b, d, p no-q.
texts.r:skill:e.e3.snd1: Umsindo wokuqala wegama uxhumene nohlamvu lwalo lokuqala. Thola amagama aqala ngomsindo ofanayo ukuze ufunde ukuthi imisindo nokuhlobanisa kuhlobene kanjani. Kwesinye isikhathi izinhlamvu ezimbili, njenge-ph, zenza umsindo we-f.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.qneg: Qala umbuzo nge-**Do/Does**. Ukuze usho cha, sebenzisa i-**don't/doesn't**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.tense: Kwamanje noma imikhuba, sebenzisa i-**present**. Kwesikhathi esedlule, engeza **-ed**. Ezintweni ozozenza, sebenzisa **will + isenzo esiyisisekelo**.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.adj: Amagama afana ne-big, small, hot ne-cold achaza ukuthi into ibukeka noma izwakala kanjani.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.prep: Sebenzisa i-**on**, i-**in**, i-**under** ne-**behind** ukuze usho ukuthi izinto ziphi.
texts.r:skill:e.e4.read: Thola ukuthi ngubani owenze ini, nokuthi kuphi, embhalweni, bese uphendula.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.gram: Sebenzisa i-**an** ngaphambi komsindo wefonyela ne-**a** ngaphambi komsindo wesihlangu. Kwento eyodwa, sebenzisa i-**There is**. Kwezinto eziningi, sebenzisa i-**There are**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.comp: Ukuze uqhathanise izinto ezimbili, sebenzisa i-**-er + than**. Kwe-'the most', sebenzisa i-**the -est**. Kumagama amade, sebenzisa i-**more**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.future: Ezintweni ozozenza, sebenzisa **will + isenzo esiyisisekelo** noma **be going to + isenzo esiyisisekelo**.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.transform: Ekuphikiseni, sebenzisa i-**not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Embuzweni, beka i-**Are / Do / Does** ekuqaleni komusho.
texts.r:skill:e.e5.read: Imibhalo emide ilula uma uthola ukuthi ngubani, kuphi, nini nokuthi yini, sengathi uyagcizelela ngaphansi.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.tense: Ezintweni ezenzeka manje, sebenzisa i-**be + -ing**. Kwesikhathi esedlule, sebenzisa i-**past tense**. Kwesikhathi esizayo, sebenzisa i-**will / be going to**.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.modal: I-**can** (ukukwazi), i-**must** (ukuphoqeleka), i-**should** (kuyisu elihle), i-**may** (kuvunyelwe) kulandelwa yisimo esiyisisekelo sesenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.vocab: Funda amagama anezincazelo ezifanayo nezingqubuzanayo ndawonye, futhi isilulumagama sakho sizophindeka kabili.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.read: Funda umbhalo onemisho eminingi bese uthola ukuthi ngubani owenze okuthile, nini nokuthi kungani.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.seq1: Amagama abonisa ukulandelana, afana ne-**First**, **Then / Next**, **After that** ne-**Finally**, akutshela ngokulandelana okwenzeka ngakho izinto.
texts.r:skill:e.e6.pun1: Umusho uqala nge-**letha enkulu** futhi uphela ngophawu olufanele lokuphumula: ichashazi (.) esitatimendeni, uphawu lombuzo (?) embuzweni, nophawu lokumemeza (!) ekumangaleleni noma emizweni ebukhali. Amagama abantu negama elithi I njalo abhalwa ngoletha omkhulu.
texts.r:skill:e.vocab: Funda amagama avamile **umsindo + incazelo + ukubhala** ndawonye futhi uzowakhumbula isikhathi eside. Thinta inkinobho yesipikha ukuze uzwe ukuthi akhulunywa kanjani.
texts.r:skill:e.be: Isenzi esithi be siguqula isimo salo ngokwesihloko. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
texts.r:skill:e.pres: Uma isihloko sithi **he / she / it (umuntu wesithathu obodwa)**, engeza **-s / -es** esenzweni. Amagama aphela nge-ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o athatha -es. Kwesicubu + y, shintsha y ibe i bese ungeza -es!
texts.r:skill:e.plural: Ukuze ukhulume ngababili noma ngaphezulu, ngokuvamile engeza **-s** egameni. Amagama aphela nge-x athatha **-es**. Funda ngekhanda amanani angajwayelekile. Umusho uhamba kanje: **isenzi → isenzo → okunye**.
texts.r:skill:e.order: Ukuze ukhulume ngababili noma ngaphezulu, ngokuvamile engeza **-s** egameni. Amagama aphela nge-x athatha **-es**. Funda ngekhanda amanani angajwayelekile. Umusho uhamba kanje: **isenzi → isenzo → okunye**.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.perf: have/has + isenzo esedlule (past participle). Sibonisa isipiliyoni, ukuphela noma ukuqhubeka. Hlukanisa phakathi kwe-since (iphuzu esikhathini) ne-for (ubude besikhathi).
texts.r:skill:e.m2.pass: Sebenzisa be + past participle ukuze usho ukuthi okuthile kwenziwa umuntu noma into. Engeza owenzayo nge-by.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.inf: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive; enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V kubonisa inhloso, futhi stop + V-ing kusho ukumisa isenzo.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.comp: -er/-est kanye ne-more/most. Sebenzisa than nokuqhathanisa ne-the nokuphakeme. good → better → best akujwayelekile.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.read: Funda umbuzo kuqala, bese uthola umusho oyinkomba. Isihloko nombono oyinhloko kuhlanganisa wonke umbhalo.
texts.r:skill:e.m2.sum1: Ukuze wenze isifinyezo, thola **umbono oyinhloko** bese uwunciphisela emishweni eyodwa noma emibili. Umusho ngolwazi olulodwa nje, owengeza okungekho esiqeshini, noma obanzi kakhulu awusona isifinyezo esihle.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.rel: Hlanganisa imisho emibili ibe munye nge-who (abantu), which (izinto), that (kokubili) ne-whose (ubunikazi).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.cond: If + present, will + V (okuthile okungenzeka). If + past, would + V (ukucabanga ngento engeyona iqiniso manje).
texts.r:skill:e.m3.ques: Sebenzisa uhlelo izwi lombuzo + isihloko + isenzo. Ungasebenzisi do/does/did.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.part: -ing iyasebenza noma iyaqhubeka; -ed iyalinyazwa noma iphelile. Ezimweni zemizwa, sebenzisa -ing kokudala umuzwa kanye ne-ed komuntu ozwayo.
texts.r:skill:e.m3.read: Hlanganisa izinkomba ukuze wenze isiphetho. Nquma inhloso yombhalo ngokubheka izicelo nezimangalo zawo.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.tense: had + p.p. ngokwenzeka ngaphambi kwesinye isehlakalo esidlule. have been -ing ngesenzo esiqhubeke kuze kube manje.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.clause: where / when / why yizihlobiso ezisebenza njengezabizwana zesenzo. whether / that zethula izigatshana zebizo.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.partc: Susa isixhumi nesihloko, bese uguqula isenzo sibe -ing. Isihloko kufanele sifane emaqenjini womabili.
texts.r:skill:e.h1.conn: Hlukanisa isizathu nomphumela (so, therefore), ukuphikisana (however), izibonelo (for example) nokwengeza (in addition).
texts.r:skill:e.h1.main: Umbono oyinhloko ngokuvamile ulandela i-However, eguqula inkolelo evamile, nasemshweni wokugcina. Gcwalisa isikhala ngokulandela ukugeleza inkinga → isixazululo → umphumela.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.inv: Uma i-Never/Hardly/Only then iqala, uhlelo luba isenzeli + isihloko. Sebenzisa i-It is ~ that ukugcizelela.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.subj: Ezigatshaneni ze-I wish / as if / If, sebenzisa i-past ukuze ushiye okuphambene namanje ne-had p.p. okuphambene nokwedlule.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.wh: whatever, whoever, whichever ne-however + isichasiso zisho 'noma yini / ubani / yiliphi / kanjani noma ...'.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.vocab: Linganisela incazelo yegama elisha ngezinkomba zokuphikisana, isibonelo nesizathu, nangesiqalo salo.
texts.r:skill:e.h2.logic: Landela umbhalo usebenzisa lokho amagama akhomba akubhekise kukho namagama axhumayo. Qoqa imininingwane ukuze ufinyelele esiphethweni.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.par: Amabinzana axhunywe nge-and/but/or athatha ifomu elifanayo. Isenzo siyavumelana nesihloko esiyinhloko.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.tone: Thola isimo sengqondo emagameni achazayo nawemizwa. Thola inhloso ngokuhlola ukuthi umbhalo uyabuza, uyazisa noma uyakholisa.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.ins: Sebenzisa amagama axhumayo, amagama akhomba nokulandelana kwesikhathi njengezinkomba ukuze uhlele imisho futhi uthole lapho umusho onikeziwe ufanele khona.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.col: Funda amapheya amagama ahamba ndawonye, njenge-make a decision, take a risk ne-heavy rain. Linganisela incazelo yezisho ngesimo.
texts.r:skill:e.h3.sum: Thola umbono oyinhloko nemishwana ephikisanayo embhalweni bese uyifinyeza ibe umusho owodwa.
texts.r:skill:e.h.conv: Emibuzweni yengxoxo, hlola hhayi ukuthi uhlelo lolimi lulungile kuphela kodwa nokuthi ithoni ibonakala yemvelo futhi yenhlonipho kuleso simo. Izikhulumi, ukuphazamisa, ukuphendula ekudumisweni, izisho nenkulumo engaqondile kuvela kaningi.
texts.r:skill:e.h.job: Ezilimini zasemsebenzini, amaphuzu abalulekile yizisho (touch base), izifinyezo (ASAP, njll.) nemibhangqwana yesenzo nesiphawulo (ama-collocation). Ungahumushi igama negama; zikhumbule njengezingxenye ezisetshenziswa ezimweni zomsebenzi.
texts.r:skill:e.h.media: Ezilimini zemidiya, kubalulekile ukuhlukanisa amaqiniso nemibono nokwahlulela ukuthi ingabe ukucabanga okusesimangalweni kuyiqiniso. Khumbula amagama afana nezincazelo zezithombe (alt text, caption) namathuluzi okuhlela ngenjongo yawo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.world: Ezihlokweni zamasiko omhlaba, funda amagama abalulekile afana namasiko, ukuhlukahluka ne-stereotype, kanye nezisho zokuzama ukuqonda amanye amasiko ngaphandle kokuwahlulela. Hlukanisa amagama afanayo usebenzisa izinkomba zomongo.
texts.r:skill:e.h.lit: Emibuzweni yezincwadi, okubalulekile ukwazi incazelo yegama bese uyisebenzisa esigabeni sendaba. Gcina ukubikezela, uphawu, indawo yokubuka, indikimba nezindima zabalingiswa zihlukene.
texts.r:skill:e.h.debate: Impikiswano idinga ukuhlukanisa amagama (isiphakamiso, impendulo, njll.), izinhlobo zobufakazi namaphutha okucabanga. Uma uhlola isimangalo, buza kuqala, "Bungubani ubufakazi balokhu?"
texts.r:skill:e.h.write: Ekubhaleni, khetha uhlobo olufanele inhloso nomfundi, futhi uhlole izingxenye zomusho (isihloko nesenzo) nokuqonda kwezixhumi. Emibhalweni ethile efana ne-resume, izenzo nezinombolo zingcono kunamagama angacacile.
texts.w:부탁해요: igama lenhlonipho elisetshenziswa lapho kucelwa into

texts.w:이미: ngaphambi manje noma kusenesikhathi kunalokho okulindelekile

texts.w:우유: uketshezi olumhlophe olwenziwa izinkomo luphuzwe njengesiphuzo

texts.why:eb-1387413b-q1: UMina wathi, "Amaqembu amathathu asekhethe lokho," ngakho uMina uyakulahla ngoba amanye amaqembu asekhethe isihloko esifanayo.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q2: UMina uthi abahluleli kungenzeka bahlukane umxhwele futhi uthanda isihloko "esingajwayelekile kakhulu", ngakho singaphetha ngokuthi uMina ufuna iphrojekthi ehlukile kwezinye.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q3: Ukuthi isihlungi samanzi "singajwayelekile" kakhulu kunentaba-mlilo kusho ukuthi asijwayelekile.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q4: Ngemva kokuba umbono wentaba-mlilo ulahliwe, uJoon washo lokhu ukuphakamisa enye indlela.
texts.why:eb-1387413b-q5: Ekugcineni, uMina wathi, "Ngizokwenza uhlu namhlanje ebusuku."
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q1: U-Abel wathi, "Ngamunye wethu unamadola ayishumi kuphela." Amadola angamashumi amabili yimali abanayo ndawonye.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q2: UJun ebelokhu ezama izindlela zokupheka ezintsha, ngakho ungabona ukuthi uJun unentshisekelo yokupheka.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q3: Kusho ukuthi incwadi yokupheka iyisipho esihle esibonisa ukuthi bacabange ngoJun.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q4: ULena usho lokhu ukukhombisa ukuthi ndawonye banamadola angamashumi amabili, anele ukuthenga incwadi ebiza amadola ayishumi nesishiyagalombili.
texts.why:eb-6da6eda4-q5: Ekugcineni uLena wathi, "Okokuqala ngizobheka amahora okuvula esitolo."
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q1: UJisu wathi utshani obumanzi abujabulisi futhi onogwayi bazonamba.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q2: UBen uthi, "Ngizofona ngiyibhukhe namuhla," ngakho ungabona ukuthi ikamelo kumele libhukhelwe kuqala.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q3: Kushiwo ekuphenduleni isizathu sikaJisu, ngaphambi kokuphakamisa enye indlela, ngakho "Fair enough" kusho ukwamukela umbono womunye umuntu.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q4: "No way" yindlela yokuvuma ngokuqinile ukuphika isiphakamiso sokuyeka.
texts.why:eb-950a868c-q5: UBen wathi, "Ngizofona ngiyibhukhe namuhla." Ukutshela abanye kuwumsebenzi kaJisu.
texts.why:eb-d512193c-q3: UJun utshele uSora ukuthi alethe ibhodlela lamanzi kuphela. Ikhayithi seselilungisiwe likaSora.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q1: Umsebenzi wesitolo wathi "amanzi acwebile njalo ngeviki." Kabili ngosuku yinani lezikhathi inhlanzi ezondliwa ngalo.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q2: USora ukhathazeke ngokuthi ithangi linomsebenzi omkhulu futhi uthi uzoqala ngenhlanzi yabaqalayo, ngakho ungabona ukuthi uSora akakaze agcine izinhlanzi.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q3: Kule nkulumo, inhlanzi yegolide ilungele abantu abagcina izinhlanzi okokuqala, ngakho "beginners" kusho abantu abasanda kuqala.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q4: Ngokubuza ukuthi inhlanzi idinga ukunakekelwa kangaki, uSora ufuna ukwazi ukuthi umsebenzi mkhulu kangakanani.
texts.why:eb-da93424c-q5: Ekugcineni umsebenzi wesitolo wathi, "Ake ngikufunele ithangi elincane."
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q2: Ukufaka ijazi lemvula "just in case" kubonisa ukuthi uNoah ucabanga ukuthi kungase kuna kodwa akaqinisekile.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q3: Kule nkulumo, uma kuna kakhulu uzobe "soaked", okusho ukuba manzi kakhulu.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q4: "If I were you" yisisho esisetshenziselwa ukunikeza umuntu iseluleko.
texts.why:eb-e6a4c5e4-q5: U-Ella wacela, "Text me when you arrive," ngakho u-Noah cishe uzomthumelela u-Ella umlayezo uma efika lapho.
